__doc: Positive cases for a finding that cites ONLY a line the PR did not touch, because the change is what made it a violation (an import whose last use was removed, a doc comment the new body contradicts), each with a control where nothing is wrong. The diff is built with convertToUnifiedDiffWithLineNumbers, the form production feeds the shard. expectedPublished counts findings per case. Used to decide whether the shard may drop findings on unchanged lines: run with `node evals/kody-rules/context-fp-repro.js --cases=cases-untouched-line --reps=3`.

cases.why: The change removes the last use of formatDate. Line 1, the import, is untouched context, and it is now the violation: the only correct finding cites it.

rule.title: No unused imports
rule.rule: Every import must be used in the file. Remove imports that nothing references.

cases.why: The change drops the tax from the return value. The doc comment on line 3 still says "including tax" and is untouched context: the only correct finding cites it.

rule.title: Doc comments must match the code
rule.rule: A doc comment must describe what the function it documents actually does. Fix or remove a comment that no longer matches the code.

cases.why: Control for the first case: the import is still used after the change, so nothing is wrong and nothing should be published.
